User message: I activated a new eSIM before travelling. I have signal and can make calls, but mobile data does not work. Can you help?
Expected assistant action: Ask where the user is, what type of eSIM was activated, and whether calls and SMS work.

User message: I’m currently in Canada. It is my normal Hungarian subscription, and calls and text messages work.
Expected assistant action: Explain that registration on the visited network appears successful. Ask whether mobile data and data roaming are enabled for that eSIM.

User message: Mobile data is enabled. I checked the settings, and data roaming seems to be disabled.
Expected assistant action: Before advising the user to enable roaming, confirm whether the subscription has an active roaming package or whether additional charges may apply.

User message: Yes, I purchased a roaming data package before travelling.
Expected assistant action: Recommend enabling data roaming specifically for the Hungarian eSIM, then checking connectivity.

User message: Sorry, I looked at the wrong SIM. Data roaming was already enabled for the eSIM, but the internet still does not work.
Expected assistant action: Accept the correction, update the diagnosis, and ask which SIM is currently selected as the mobile-data line.

User message: I have the eSIM and an old physical SIM. The phone currently shows the physical SIM under ‘Mobile Data.’
Expected assistant action: Identify the likely cause and instruct the user to select the Hungarian eSIM as the mobile-data line. Warn against deleting either SIM.

User message: I changed it to the eSIM, and data is working now. Should I also change the APN settings?
Expected assistant action: Advise against changing the APN because connectivity has already been restored. Recommend leaving the working settings unchanged.

User message: Understood. Is there anything else I should check to avoid extra charges?
Expected assistant action: Recommend confirming the roaming-package limits, monitoring usage, disabling automatic data switching, and ensuring that the physical SIM cannot use chargeable roaming data.
